notes: Page title 'Healthy Wheat Wraps' with subtitle 'Kaloreez wraps you with the warmth of health and hygiene'. Kaloreez brand logo (green circular logo, tagline 'A blend of taste, health and hygiene') top right. Grey background with faint gear/cog pattern; white decorative medieval-style serif headings, black bold serif item names, dark maroon descriptions. Green dot = veg, red dot = non-veg markers. Each item has a nutrition table (kCal, Fat (g), Carb(g), Protein(g)) in maroon-outlined boxes, captured in extra 'nutrition' field. Bottom: food photo of grilled wheat wrap with chips, dip and corn. Prices formatted 'NNN/-'. No tax/charges info. Fully legible. Note: Lettuce Wraps nutrition is identical to Protein Wrap (as printed). Protein Wrap and Lettuce Wraps have no veg/non-veg dot.
